y-m-33-02.goal: Bonisa ngemizekelo emininzi enokwenzeka ukuba isishiyekileyo xa kwahlulwa ngebinzana le-quadratic asinakumiselwa xa kwaziwa ixabiso elinye kuphela, uthi luluphi olunye ulwazi olufuneka lwaziwe, uze ufumane ngokwenene isishiyekileyo.
y-m-33-02.material: P(x) yi-polynomial enamaqondo okwenene kwaye idigri yayo ayaziwa. Inyani enye kuphela eyaziwayo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku: xa P(x) ihlulwa ngu-x−1, intsalela yi-3. UJiyun uthe, 'Intsalela xa P(x) ihlulwa ngu-(x−1)(x−2) yi-3,' kwaye uHajun uthe, 'Asikwazi ukuxela ngolwazi lwangoku.' Vumela Q(x) libe sisiphumo sokwahlula kwaye R(x) libe yintsalela xa P(x) ihlulwa ngu-(x−1)(x−2). Ngoko P(x) = (x−1)(x−2)Q(x) + R(x), kwaye idigri ka-R(x) incinci kune-2. (Indlela yokufunda: P(x) ngu-'P ka-x', (x−1)(x−2) ngu-'x ukususa 1 iphindwe x ukususa 2')
y-m-33-02.thinking.2: Ukugqiba isiphelo ngolwazi olongezelelweyo nokuphikisa indlela emfutshane engalunganga
y-m-33-02.prereq.1: Intsingiselo yesiphumo sokwahlula nentsalela xa i-polynomial ihlulwa yi-polynomial: A = BQ + R kwaye idigri ka-R incinci kunedigri ka-B
y-m-33-02.prereq.3: Ukusombulula inkqubo yolingano lomgca (izinto ezimbini ezingaziwayo)
y-m-33-02.s.s1.prompt: Sesiphi isigwebo esifaneleke kakhulu malunga nokuba R(x) ingafunyanwa kulwazi olwaziwayo ngoku kuphela?
y-m-33-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuba R(x) inobuphi ubume nokuba mangaphi amanani akuyo afuna ukumiselwa.
y-m-33-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bala ukuba zingaphi izilingano ezinikwa zizinyani ezaziwayo ngoku kula manani, uze uthelekise.
y-m-33-02.s.s1.r.a: Esi sigwebo sithatha intsalela ye-3 ekwahluleni ngu-x−1 njengefanayo nentsalela R(x) ekwahluleni yintetho yekhwadratiki. Xa umahluli etshintsha, ubume bentsalela buyatshintsha nabo.
y-m-33-02.s.s1.r.b: Nokuba asiyazi idigri, ubume bentsalela xa kwahlulwa yintetho yekhwadratiki, idigri ye-1 okanye ngaphantsi, bumisiwe. Awukakachongi ngokuchanekileyo ukuba ulwazi luni olufunekayo.
y-m-33-02.s.s1.r.c: Esi sigwebo sibala ukuba mangaphi amanani kwintsalela afuna ukumiselwa sibone ukuba ulwazi lwangoku lunika inxalenye yawo kuphela.
y-m-33-02.s.s1.o.d: Ayinakufunyanwa. Kufuneka sazi isiphumo sokwahlula Q(x)
y-m-33-02.s.s1.r.d: Nokuba asiwazi isiphumo sokwahlula, ukuba ufaka x eyenza isiphumo sokwahlula sinyamalale, unokufumana ulingano malunga nentsalela. Awubonanga ukuba isiphumo sokwahlula sifuneka ngokwenene.
y-m-33-02.s.s1.explain: R(x) inobume bika-ax+b, ngoko kukho amanani amabini ekufuneka amiselwe, a no-b. Inyani enye kuphela eyaziwayo yulingano olunye ku-a+b, ngoko R(x) ayikwazi ukumiselwa okwangoku. Okufunekayo akuyidigri okanye isiphumo sokwahlula, kodwa ukuba P ingakanani kwelinye ixabiso lika-x apho isiphumo sokwahlula sinyamalala khona.
y-m-33-02.s.s2.prompt: R(x) = ax + b (a no-b ngamanani aphelele ukusuka kwi−5 ukuya kwi-8). Yenza iinqununu ezi-3 (a, b), nge-a eyahlukileyo, ezingaphikisani nenyani eyaziwayo ethi 'intsalela xa kwahlulwa ngu-x−1 yi-3'.
y-m-33-02.s.s2.hint.0: Jonga ukuba ngowuphi umqondiso oba ngu-0 xa ufaka x = 1 kwi-P(x) = (x−1)(x−2)Q(x) + R(x).
y-m-33-02.s.s2.hint.1: Misela a enye, ulungise b ukugcwalisa inyani eyaziwayo, uze uphinde inkqubo efanayo emva kokutshintsha a.

y-m-33-02.s.s3.prompt: Ngoku ufunda inyani eyongezelelweyo ethi 'intsalela xa P(x) ihlulwa ngu-x−2 yi-5'. Bhala ukuba R(x) ngoku imiselwe njengenye na, yintoni R(x) ukuba imiselwe, nokuba 'intsalela yi-3' kaJiyun ichanekile na.
y-m-33-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale ulingano olufumana ngokufaka x = 2, ubonise indlela inyani entsha enokudityaniswa ngayo no-R(x) = ax + b.
y-m-33-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bala ukuba zingaphi izilingano ezi-a no-b ngoku, uze ufumane a no-b kuzo.
y-m-33-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale izilingano ezidibanisa amaxabiso e-P(1) ne-P(2) no-R(x) nganye?
y-m-33-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uhlolile ngokufaka kwakhona x = 1, 2 kwi-R(x) oyifumeneyo ukubona ukuba i-3 nesi-5 ziyaphuma?

y-m-33-02.s.s3.model.0: Ukufaka P(1)=3 ne-P(2)=5 kwi-R(x)=ax+b kunika a+b=3 kunye ne-2a+b=5, ngoko a=2, b=1 kwaye R(x)=2x+1. 'Intsalela yi-3' kaJiyun yi-R(1)=3 kuphela kwaye R(x) ayiyi-3, ngoko ayichanekanga.
y-m-33-02.s.s3.model.1: Ngamaxabiso omabini, R(x) imiselwe njengenye. Kwi-R(x)=ax+b, ukusombulula a+b=3 kunye ne-2a+b=5 njengenkqubo kunika a=2, b=1. Ngoko intsalela yi-2x+1, kwaye ibango likaJiyun lokuba yi-3 alichanekanga.

y-m-33-10.title: Ikhwotyenti nentsalela xa kwahlulwa ngu-2x−1: ukuhlola esi sisombululo
y-m-33-10.topic: Ukwahlula okufinyeziweyo nokwahlula ngentetho elayinini onomlinganiselo ongeyo-1
y-m-33-10.goal: Hlalutya oko kuhlala kunjalo noko kutshintshayo xa useka isiphumo sokwahlula ngu-x−1/2 kwisiphumo sokwahlula ngu-2x−1, wenze iintetho ezininzi ezanelisa imeko yentsalela.
y-m-33-10.material: Umfundi owayefuna ukufumana ikhwotyenti nentsalela xa kwahlulwa P(x) = 2x³ − 3x² + x − 5 ngu-2x − 1 wasebenzisa ukwahlula okufinyeziweyo wasombulula ngolu hlobo lulandelayo. (Indlela yokufunda: 2x³ yi-'2 x ikyubhu', 2x−1 yi-'2x ukususa 1', 1/2 yi-'isiqingatha')

y-m-33-10.thinking.1: Ukuhlalutya ubudlelwane phakathi kwekhwotyenti nentsalela xa intetho enye ihlulwa ziintetho ezahlukeneyo ezilayinini
y-m-33-10.thinking.2: Ukwenza nokuqinisekisa iintetho ezininzi ezihambelana nemeko
y-m-33-10.prereq.1: Indlela yokufumana ikhwotyenti nentsalela xa kwahlulwa ngu-x−k kusetyenziswa ukwahlula okufinyeziweyo
y-m-33-10.s.s1.prompt: Kwisisombululo somfundi, khetha umgca oqulathe isigqibo esingaphumi kwimigca yangaphambili.
y-m-33-10.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuba uyahlulayo ngubani kumgca 3 nakumgca 4, uze uthelekise.
y-m-33-10.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala ukulingana kokwahlula P(x) = (uyahlulayo) × (ikhwotyenti) + intsalela usebenzisa isiphumo somgca 3, uze uphinde ubhale uyahlulayo njenge-2x − 1.
y-m-33-10.s.s1.line.0: Ukusuka ku-2x − 1 = 0, x = 1/2, ngoko senza ukwahlula okufinyeziweyo nge-1/2.
y-m-33-10.s.s1.line.2: Ngoko ikhwotyenti xa P(x) ihlulwa ngu-x − 1/2 yi-2x² − 2x kwaye intsalela yi-−5.
y-m-33-10.s.s1.line.3: Oko kukuthi, ikhwotyenti xa P(x) ihlulwa ngu-2x − 1 yi-2x² − 2x kwaye intsalela yi-−5.
y-m-33-10.s.s1.explain: Ngumgca 4. Ukubala kwimigca 1 ukuya kwi-3 kulungile. Ikhwotyenti 2x²−2x efunyenwe ngokwahlula okufinyeziweyo yikhwotyenti xa kwahlulwa ngu-x−1/2. Kufuneka ukhuphe u-2, njengo-P(x) = (x−1/2)(2x²−2x) − 5 = (2x−1)(x²−x) − 5, ukufumana ikhwotyenti xa kwahlulwa ngu-2x−1. Intsalela −5 iyafana kwiimeko zombini.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.prompt: Khetha zonke iinkcazelo ezichanekileyo ezithelekisa ukwahlula P(x) efanayo ngu-x − 1/2 nangu-2x − 1.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.hint.0: Kwi-P = (x−1/2)Q + R, bhala ukuba lelinani elinjani elihambela phi xa uphinda ubhale (x−1/2) njenge-(2x−1).
y-m-33-10.s.s2.hint.1: Emva kokuyihambisa, thelekisa oko kungena endaweni yekhwotyenti nentsalela.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.r.a: Olu luvo lubona amakhwotyenti njengafanayo nangona abahlulayo bahlukile. Kulingano P = BQ + R, hlola ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kwi-Q xa B ihlukile.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.r.b: Olu khetho lucinge ukuba kutheni intsalela ingatshintshi nokuba ifom yoyahlulayo itshintsha.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.o.c: Intsalela xa kwahlulwa ngu-2x−1 iba sisiqingatha
y-m-33-10.s.s2.r.c: Esi sigqibo sibona intsalela njengehlulwa kunye nesiphumo sokwahlula. Asizange sihlole apho intsalela imiselwa khona.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.o.d: Isiphumo sokwahlula xa kwahlulwa nge-2x−1 siba sisiqingatha
y-m-33-10.s.s2.r.d: Olu khetho lufunde ubudlelwane phakathi kwenani eliphindaphindwe kumahluli nesiphumo sokwahlula.
y-m-33-10.s.s2.explain: P = (x−1/2)·Q + R = (2x−1)·(Q/2) + R, ngoko isiphumo sokwahlula xa kwahlulwa nge-2x−1 yi-Q/2 kwaye intsalela R ayitshintshi. Apha Q = 2x²−2x, ngoko Q/2 = x²−x.
y-m-33-10.s.s3.prompt: Yenza intetho ye-cubic P(x) = ax³ + bx² + cx + d (a, b, c, d ngamanani aphelele ukusuka kwi-−9 ukuya kwi-9, kwaye a ayiyo-0) ukuze intsalela xa P(x) ihlulwa yi-2x − 1 ibe yi-3. Yenza iintetho ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo.
y-m-33-10.s.s3.hint.0: Cinga ukuba ungayibhala njani kwakhona 'intsalela yi-3' njengexabiso le-P kwixabiso elithile le-x.
y-m-33-10.s.s3.hint.1: Qala umisele ezinye zika-a, b, c, d, uze umisele oonobumba abaseleyo ukuze bahambelane nemeko.
y-m-33-10.s.s3.fail.c2: Ukuba ikoyifishenti a ye-x³ ngu-0, asiyiyo intetho ye-cubic.
y-m-33-10.s.s3.fail.c3: Intsalela ayiyi-3. Khangela ukuba ixabiso le-P kwi-x eyenza i-2x−1=0 li-3 na.
y-m-33-10.s.s3.explain: Intsalela xa kwahlulwa nge-2x−1 yi-P(1/2) = a/8 + b/4 + c/2 + d, kwaye le yi-3, ngoko ukuphindaphinda amacala omabini nge-8 kunika imeko a + 2b + 4c + 8d = 24. Kukho ezininzi iikwadruple zamanani aphelele ezanelisa le meko. Umzekelo, kwi-(4, 2, 4, 0), P(1/2) = 1/2 + 1/2 + 2 + 0 = 3.

y-m-33-01.title: Ukubala kukaSeojin kwe-(x−2)³ kwaphosakala phi?
y-m-33-01.topic: Ifomyula yokuphindaphinda (ukwandisa ikhyubhu) nokuhlola iimpazamo zophawu
y-m-33-01.goal: Kwisisombululo esisebenzisa ifomyula yekhyubhu kwibinzana elinenani elibi, fumana umgca wokuqala ophosakeleyo, ufunde ukuba ukuhlola ngokufaka amanani kunokuphosa impazamo kwamanye amaxabiso, uze uvavanye isiphumo esilungisiweyo wena.
y-m-33-01.material: Ngomsebenzi wasekhaya, uSeojin wandisa i-(x−2)³ usebenzisa ifomyula yokuphindaphinda (a+b)³ = a³ + 3a²b + 3ab² + b³ waza wabhala isisombululo ngemigca emihlanu. x yinani eliphawulwa ngonobumba elimele inani leqinisileyo, yaye i-−2 ifakwa endaweni ye-b kwifomyula. USeojin ufuna ukungenisa isiphumo somgca wesi-5 njengoko injalo. Masihlole ukuba singasithemba na eso siphumo. (Indlela yokufunda: x³ yi-'x ikhyubhu', (−2)² yi-'ibi 2, isikwere', 3·x·(−4) yi-'3 amaxesha x amaxesha ibi 4')

Umgca wo-1 ufake ngokuchanekileyo a=x, b=−2 kwifomyula, yaye ukubala kwimigca yesi-2 neyesi-4 nako kulunge. Umgca wesi-5 uthwale nje isiphumo somgca wesi-3 ongalunganga.
y-m-33-01.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukuhlola ngokufaka amanani kwi-x ukuba isiphumo somgca wesi-5 silunge na. Khetha onke amaxabiso e-x apho ixabiso lecala lasekhohlo (x−2)³ nexabiso lesiphumo sikaSeojin x³ − 6x² − 12x − 8 liba lahlukile, ukuze uqaphele impazamo.

y-m-33-01.s.s2.r.a: Kuyingozi ukukholelwa ukuba ilunge nje kuba amabinzana amabini aphume elinganayo kwi-x=0. Ukulingana kwixabiso elinye akubungqina bokuba amabinzana apheleleyo alingana.

y-m-33-09.topic: Iindidi zefomyula yokuphindaphinda: isixa nemveliso, nemeko yokubakho kwamanani okwenyani
y-m-33-09.goal: Qaphela ukuba ixabiso elifunyenwe kusetyenziswa uhlobo lwefomyula yokuphindaphinda lingaphuma ngokwefom nokuba amanani okwenyani anjalo angekho, uze ufumane uchaze wena imeko yokuba abekho.
